perks.name: Mining Fiesta
perks.description: Gain +25☯ Mining Wisdom, +25%  Mining Fortune, and collect Refined Minerals and Glossy Gemstones from mining!

perks.name: Sharing is Caring
perks.description: Unlocks 2 more Exp Share slots in your pets menu and increases the Exp Share rate by +10%!

perks.name: Stock Exchange
perks.description: Participate in the Stonks Auction for a chance to win Stock of Stonks! Trade them for extravagant items at the Trade Center.

perks.name: Volume Trading
perks.description: The available item quantity per Shen's Auction has been doubled, and two additional Shen's Special auctions will be available if Diaz is Mayor.

perks.name: Pest Eradicator
perks.description: The duration of Pesthunter Phillip's  Farming Fortune bonus is now 60m. Decreases the spawn cooldown of Pests by 20%.

perks.name: Blooming Business
perks.description: All Garden Visitors reward Fine Flour and +10% Copper for accepting offers. Invites 5 unique visitors to your Garden and makes higher rarity visitors 20% more likely to show up.

perks.name: A Time for Giving
perks.description: Spawn Party Chests by killing mobs during the Spooky Festival and collect Party Gifts from Jerry's Workshop.

perks.name: Chivalrous Carnival
perks.description: Schedules a Carnival in the hub, active throughout the entire year.

perks.name: Extra Event
perks.description: Schedules an extra Fishing Festival event during the year.

perks.name: Fishing XP Buff
perks.description: Gain +50☯ Fishing Wisdom on public islands.
